parts.name: shell dome

physics.Basic_description: Large red spherical main body of the helmet with a smooth, matte finish.
physics.Functional_description: Primary protective shell covering the head and absorbing impact.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the large curved surface from the top or sides with a parallel jaw gripper.
physics.reason: Helmet shells are thin-walled composite or plastic structures enclosing air/foam, not solid blocks.

parts.description: Large red spherical main body of the helmet with a smooth, matte finish.
parts.function: Primary protective shell covering the head and absorbing impact.

parts.name: chin trim

physics.Basic_description: Green curved strip along the lower edge of the chin area, appearing soft and matte.
physics.Functional_description: Protective trim or seal for the chin bar edge.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to grasp reliably; avoid.
physics.reason: Rubber trim is typically a solid extruded or molded strip.

parts.description: Green curved strip along the lower edge of the chin area, appearing soft and matte.
parts.function: Protective trim or seal for the chin bar edge.

parts.name: rear spoiler

physics.Basic_description: Blue aerodynamic fin attached to the rear of the helmet shell.
physics.Functional_description: Reduces drag and lift at high speeds.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped carefully, but fragile; better to grasp the main shell.
physics.reason: Aerodynamic spoilers are typically thin injection-molded plastic shells.

parts.description: Blue aerodynamic fin attached to the rear of the helmet shell.

parts.name: visor panel

physics.Basic_description: Large purple curved panel acting as the face shield/visor.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the face from wind and debris; can be lifted.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the edge of the visor to lift or close it.
physics.reason: Visors are thin sheets of polycarbonate, not solid blocks.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
